comment: The Haro v0.6 conformance floor, written BEFORE the court that passes it (the W discipline: fixtures first, prose second). v0.6 grows v0.5 by what a declared WORLD needs to be forged whole -- its court AND its runtime -- from its declaration (haro/SPIKE.md, the sixth rung: Z, the alphabet's Z letter, zing's 16 tontine cases): a list of a FORM that is a name and a scalar, written as name: value pairs (an entity's fields); every other FORM keeps v0.1's reading, because the pinned judge lists a six-seat FORM; an EXPRESSION's semantics declared -- what an absent reference reads as (ABSENT), what a division by zero yields (DIVISION), whether a number and a text can be equal (EQUALITY); and WALK, the one kinetic declaration: which kind is walked, which kind its steps are, how a step names its walk and its rank, which of its seats are guards, which compute a value, which names the failure. Every v0.5 fixture still passes: v0.6 refuses nothing v0.5 accepted. Rejects carry the fragment the refusal must contain.

accepts.name: a list of a FORM with two scalar seats: its items are written as name: value pairs (an entity's fields)
accepts.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE z AS (VERSION "0.6", GRAMMAR "0.6", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".z") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE FORM field AS (SEATS [name: name, type: name]) RATIONALE "a field is a name and a type"
DEFINE DECLARATION entity AS (VERB "ENTITY", SEATS [fields: [field]]) RATIONALE "x"

accepts.name: an EXPRESSION declares its semantics: ABSENT zero or refuse, DIVISION calm or refuse, EQUALITY kind or value
accepts.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE z AS (VERSION "0.6", GRAMMAR "0.6", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".z") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE EXPRESSION zexpr AS (OPERATORS [or, and, cmp, add, sub, mul, div, round], OPERANDS [number, text, flag, ref, agg], AGGREGATES [sum, count], ABSENT zero, DIVISION calm, EQUALITY value) RATIONALE "calm arithmetic: a missing value counts as 0 and division by zero yields 0"

accepts.name: a seat typed by an EXPRESSION holds an expression text the court parses with the expression's own menus
accepts.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE z AS (VERSION "0.6", GRAMMAR "0.6", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".z") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE EXPRESSION zexpr AS (OPERATORS [or, and, cmp], OPERANDS [number, text, ref]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION norm AS (VERB "NORM", SEATS [rule: zexpr, message: text]) RATIONALE "x"

accepts.name: a WALK: OF the walked kind, STEPS its steps' kind, THROUGH the step's reference to its walk, ORDER its rank, GUARDS the expression seats that must hold (a path reads through a reference), COMPUTE and FORMULA the computed field and its expression, FAIL the seat naming the failure
accepts.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE z AS (VERSION "0.6", GRAMMAR "0.6", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".z") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE EXPRESSION zexpr AS (OPERATORS [or, and, cmp, add, sub, mul, div, round], OPERANDS [number, text, ref, agg], AGGREGATES [sum, count], ABSENT zero, DIVISION calm, EQUALITY value) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE MENU actors AS (WORDS [collector, treasurer, system]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION norm AS (VERB "NORM", SEATS [rule: zexpr, message: text]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION flow AS (VERB "FLOW", SEATS []) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION step AS (VERB "STEP", SEATS [flow: flow, order: number, actor: actors, validate: zexpr?, enforcing: norm?, compute: name?, formula: zexpr?, on_fail: text?]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE WALK flows AS (OF flow, STEPS step, THROUGH flow, ORDER order, GUARDS [validate, enforcing.rule], COMPUTE compute, FORMULA formula, FAIL on_fail) RATIONALE "a record walks a flow's steps in order; a guard that fails stops it there"

accepts.name: a v0.5 declaration is a v0.6 declaration: v0.5's A1, unchanged
accepts.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE w AS (VERSION "0.1", GRAMMAR "0.1", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".w") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE EXPRESSION w AS (OPERATORS [or, and, not, cmp, add, sub, mul, div, mod, neg], OPERANDS [number, text, var], VARIABLES [item, accumulator], CONTEXTS [eval: [], map: [item], reduce: [accumulator, item]]) RATIONALE "the seats fix the variables"

rejects.name: ABSENT takes zero, missing or refuse
rejects.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE z AS (VERSION "0.6", GRAMMAR "0.6", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".z") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE EXPRESSION zexpr AS (OPERATORS [cmp], OPERANDS [number, ref], ABSENT nil) RATIONALE "x"
rejects.refusal: ABSENT takes zero, missing or refuse

rejects.name: DIVISION takes calm or refuse
rejects.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE z AS (VERSION "0.6", GRAMMAR "0.6", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".z") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE EXPRESSION zexpr AS (OPERATORS [div], OPERANDS [number], DIVISION infinity) RATIONALE "x"

rejects.name: EQUALITY takes kind or value
rejects.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE z AS (VERSION "0.6", GRAMMAR "0.6", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".z") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE EXPRESSION zexpr AS (OPERATORS [cmp], OPERANDS [number, text], EQUALITY loose) RATIONALE "x"

rejects.name: a WALK's OF names a DECLARATION of this language
rejects.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE z AS (VERSION "0.6", GRAMMAR "0.6", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".z") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION step AS (VERB "STEP", SEATS [order: number]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE WALK flows AS (OF river, STEPS step, THROUGH flow, ORDER order) RATIONALE "x"

rejects.name: THROUGH is a seat of the steps' kind that refers to the walked kind
rejects.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE z AS (VERSION "0.6", GRAMMAR "0.6", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".z") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION flow AS (VERB "FLOW", SEATS []) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION step AS (VERB "STEP", SEATS [order: number, name: text]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE WALK flows AS (OF flow, STEPS step, THROUGH name, ORDER order) RATIONALE "x"
rejects.refusal: THROUGH names a seat of step that refers to flow

rejects.name: GUARDS name expression seats of the steps' kind, or a path through a reference to one
rejects.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE z AS (VERSION "0.6", GRAMMAR "0.6", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".z") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE EXPRESSION zexpr AS (OPERATORS [cmp], OPERANDS [number, ref]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE MENU actors AS (WORDS [collector]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION flow AS (VERB "FLOW", SEATS []) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION step AS (VERB "STEP", SEATS [flow: flow, order: number, actor: actors, validate: zexpr?]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE WALK flows AS (OF flow, STEPS step, THROUGH flow, ORDER order, GUARDS [actor]) RATIONALE "x"
rejects.refusal: GUARDS: 'actor' is not an expression seat

rejects.name: at most one WALK of a kind
rejects.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE z AS (VERSION "0.6", GRAMMAR "0.6", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".z") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION flow AS (VERB "FLOW", SEATS []) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION step AS (VERB "STEP", SEATS [flow: flow, order: number]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE WALK a AS (OF flow, STEPS step, THROUGH flow, ORDER order) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE WALK b AS (OF flow, STEPS step, THROUGH flow, ORDER order) RATIONALE "x"

rejects.name: a list of a FORM is written as name: value pairs when the FORM is a name and a scalar; a pair cannot hold a reference
rejects.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE z AS (VERSION "0.6", GRAMMAR "0.6", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".z") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION flow AS (VERB "FLOW", SEATS []) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE FORM hop AS (SEATS [name: name, to: flow]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION route AS (VERB "ROUTE", SEATS [hops: [hop]]) RATIONALE "x"

rejects.name: COMPUTE and FORMULA go together
rejects.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE z AS (VERSION "0.6", GRAMMAR "0.6", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".z") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE EXPRESSION zexpr AS (OPERATORS [add], OPERANDS [number, ref]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION flow AS (VERB "FLOW", SEATS []) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION step AS (VERB "STEP", SEATS [flow: flow, order: number, compute: name?, formula: zexpr?]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE WALK flows AS (OF flow, STEPS step, THROUGH flow, ORDER order, COMPUTE compute) RATIONALE "x"
